key_observations: 40m macro tower with 4 active bands (700/1800/2600/3500 MHz) provides broad spectral coverage spanning low-band (coverage) to high-band (capacity) spectrum.
6 5G cells vs 4 4G cells — 5G-dominant but retains meaningful 4G layer, making it a transitional site serving both legacy and 5G users.
Capacity score 25.6 is among the highest in the neighborhood, tied with USID_29 and USID_37, indicating the site is well-provisioned for its edge-limited footprint.
20m micro tower with only 2 active bands (2600/3500 MHz) — high-band only, no low-band 700 MHz coverage layer, indicating a dense urban capacity fill site rather than a broad coverage node.
8 5G cells vs 2 4G cells makes this the most 5G-heavy site in the neighborhood; its capacity-oriented role is well-supported by the high-band spectrum profile.
Despite micro form factor, capacity score 23.4 is strong due to heavy 5G cell count; however, limited band diversity means it will be less resilient in propagation-challenged spots.
Identical hardware profile to USID_00 (40m macro, 4 bands, 4×4G + 6×5G), making it a near-identical substitute in terms of configuration.
Full band complement including 700 MHz low-band ensures coverage continuity even at extended distances from the tower.
As the second-highest absorption backup (42.3% of USID_00 area), its matched capacity score 25.6 means no capacity penalty for users handed over to it.
35m macro with only 2 active bands (1800/2600 MHz) — mid-band only, no 700 MHz low-band or 3500 MHz high-band, limiting both coverage depth and peak 5G throughput.
8 4G cells vs 2 5G cells — heavily 4G-oriented; this is a legacy site that has received minimal 5G investment, with capacity score 15.6 significantly below the neighborhood average of ~23-26.
The low capacity score and 4G-dominant profile mean 5G users handed over here will experience 4G fallback for most sessions.
Identical hardware profile to USID_00 and USID_29 (40m macro, 4 bands, 4×4G + 6×5G), offering equivalent configuration quality as a backup.
Full band diversity including 700 MHz ensures reliable coverage even at the outer edge of its dominance zone.

48m tall_macro with full 4-band complement (700/1800/2600/3500 MHz) — optimized for broad area coverage; the tall_macro height supports wider propagation radius than standard macros.
6 4G cells vs 4 5G cells — more balanced than USID_41 but still 4G-leaning; 5G users handed over here may see partial 5G availability depending on 3500 MHz coverage in the target zone.
Capacity score 22.4 is adequate, slightly below the primary backups; its tall_macro profile makes it more of a wide-area coverage anchor than a high-density capacity node.

nsa_5g_downgrade_risk.explanation: Primary backup USID_27 has 8 5G cells (more than USID_00's 6), so no NSA 5G downgrade risk from the primary handover path. Secondary backups USID_29 and USID_37 also have 6 5G cells each. Only USID_41 (2 5G cells) and USID_31 (4 5G cells) present partial 5G degradation risk, but these are tertiary backups absorbing smaller fractions of traffic.

capacity_verdict_reasoning: Primary backup USID_27 (capacity_score 23.4) and secondary backups USID_29 and USID_37 (both 25.6) all have capacity scores at or above USID_00 (25.6), meaning the network can absorb the outage without capacity regression in the majority of the affected area.
All post_outage_load_factors from Stage 1 are <= 0.013, far below any load risk threshold, confirming existing capacity at backup sites is more than sufficient.

USID_41's lower capacity score (15.6) and 4G-dominant profile is a mild concern for the 34.6% of USID_00's area it covers, but signal quality remains good and load impact is negligible (factor 0.012).
key_findings_for_stage4: No NSA 5G downgrade risk on the primary handover path — USID_27 carries 8 5G cells, exceeding USID_00's 6.
USID_41 presents a localized 5G capacity downgrade risk for ~34.6% of USID_00's area due to its 4G-dominant profile (8×4G, 2×5G, capacity score 15.6 vs 25.6).
Three of five backup sites (USID_27, USID_29, USID_37) have capacity scores >= 23.4, confirming the neighborhood is well-provisioned for this outage.

reasons: All capacity scores read directly from preprocessing capacity_summary with no recomputation.
